title: Lemon Orzo with Chicken Thighs
description: One skillet, crisp skin, and orzo that cooks in the pan juices.

steps.text: Salt the thighs on both sides and leave them skin-up on a plate while the oven heats to 200 °C.
Lay the thighs skin-down in a cold, dry ovenproof skillet and set it over medium heat. Leave them alone until the skin releases and is deeply golden, then lift them out.
Pour off all but a tablespoon of the fat. Add the olive oil and garlic, and cook until it smells sweet rather than sharp.

steps: Stir in the orzo and toast it until the grains turn matte, then add the hot stock and the lemon zest.

steps.text: Settle the thighs back on top, skin above the liquid, and bake uncovered until the orzo has drunk the stock.

steps: Rest for five minutes off the heat, then finish with the lemon juice, parmesan and parsley.
